detours.why: Snell-Hitchcock's mapped door opens onto the Main Quadrangle to its south, and the science buildings just north of it across 57th Street are reached by leaving the quad through its Ellis Avenue gate and going round.

Max Palevsky Central's mapped entrance is on 56th Street, and the Eckhardt Research Center and Accelerator Building have their mapped doors on their far western sides off Ellis Avenue, so walks go along 56th Street and round those buildings.
